Physics.subject: Physics

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Gauss Law Derivations, Dipole Field & Torque, Flux
chapters.official_topics: Electric charges and conservation, Coulomb's law force between two point charges, superposition principle, continuous charge distribution. Electric field, electric field lines, electric dipole, electric field due to a dipole, torque on a dipole in uniform field. Electric flux, statement of Gauss's theorem and applications to uniformly charged infinite wire, infinite plane sheet, and thin spherical shell.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Dielectrics, Parallel Plate Capacitors, Energy Density, Equipotential Surfaces
chapters.official_topics: Electric potential, potential difference, electric potential due to point charge, dipole and system of charges; equipotential surfaces, electrical potential energy of a system of two point charges and electric dipoles in electrostatic field. Conductors and dielectrics, free charges and bound charges inside conductor, capacitors and capacitance, combination of capacitors in series and parallel, capacitance of parallel plate capacitor with/without dielectric, energy stored in capacitor.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Drift Velocity, Kirchhoff's Rules, Wheatstone Bridge, Temperature Coefficient
chapters.official_topics: Electric current, drift velocity, mobility and relation with current; Ohm's law, electrical resistance, V-I characteristics (linear and non-linear), electrical energy and power, resistivity and conductivity, temperature dependence of resistance. Internal resistance of cell, potential difference and EMF of cell, combination of cells in series and parallel, Kirchhoff's laws and simple applications, Wheatstone bridge.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Biot-Savart Law, Ampere's Law, Solenoid, Force on Parallel Conductors, Galvanometer to Ammeter/Voltmeter
chapters.official_topics: Concept of magnetic field, Oersted's experiment. Biot-Savart law and application to current carrying circular loop. Ampere's law and application to infinitely long straight wire and solenoid. Force on moving charge in uniform magnetic and electric fields. Force on current-carrying conductor in uniform magnetic field, force between two parallel current-carrying conductors (definition of ampere), torque on current loop in magnetic field; moving coil galvanometer (current sensitivity and conversion to ammeter/voltmeter).

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Magnetic Dipole, Earth's Magnetism, Para/Dia/Ferromagnetic Properties
chapters.official_topics: Bar magnet as equivalent solenoid qualitative, magnetic field lines, magnetic dipole moment of revolving electron; magnetic properties of materials: Para-, Dia- and Ferromagnetic substances with examples, magnetization, saturation, effect of temperature.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Faraday & Lenz Law, Motional EMF, Self & Mutual Inductance
chapters.official_topics: Electromagnetic induction; Faraday's laws, induced EMF and current; Lenz's Law, Eddy currents. Self and mutual induction.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: LCR Series Circuit, Phasors, Resonance, Power Factor, Transformer
chapters.official_topics: Alternating currents, peak and RMS value of AC; reactance and impedance; LCR series circuit (phasor diagram only), resonance; power in AC circuits, power factor, wattless current. AC generator and transformer.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Displacement Current, EM Spectrum Characteristics & Frequency Bands
chapters.official_topics: Basic idea of displacement current, Electromagnetic waves, their characteristics, their transverse nature (qualitative idea only). Electromagnetic spectrum (radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays) including elementary facts about their uses.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Refraction at Spherical Surfaces, Lens Maker Formula, Prism, Astronomical Telescope, Compound Microscope
chapters.official_topics: Ray Optics: Reflection of light, spherical mirrors, mirror formula, refraction of light, total internal reflection and optical fibers, refraction at spherical surfaces, lenses, thin lens formula, lensmaker's formula, magnification, power of a lens, combination of thin lenses in contact, refraction of light through a prism. Optical instruments: Microscopes and astronomical telescopes (reflecting and refracting) and their magnifying powers.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Huygens Principle Wavefronts, Young's Double Slit Experiment (YDSE), Single Slit Diffraction
chapters.official_topics: Wave Optics: Wave front and Huygens principle, reflection and refraction of plane wave at a plane surface using wave fronts. Proof of laws of reflection and refraction using Huygens principle. Interference, Young's double slit experiment and expression for fringe width, coherent sources and sustained interference of light. Diffraction due to a single slit, width of central maximum.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.chapter: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
chapters.typology: Photoelectric Effect Graphs, Einstein Equation, de Broglie Wavelength
chapters.official_topics: Dual nature of radiation, Photoelectric effect, Hertz and Lenard's observations; Einstein's photoelectric equation-particle nature of light. Experimental study of photoelectric effect, matter waves-wave nature of particles, de-Broglie relation.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Rutherford Model, Bohr Postulates, Hydrogen Line Spectrum (Rydberg Formula)
chapters.official_topics: Alpha-particle scattering experiment; Rutherford's model of atom; Bohr model of hydrogen atom, energy levels, hydrogen spectrum, de-Broglie explanation of Bohr second postulate of quantization.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.typology: Nuclear Density, Mass Defect & Binding Energy per Nucleon, Nuclear Fission/Fusion
chapters.official_topics: Composition and size of nucleus, nuclear force, mass-energy relation, mass defect; binding energy per nucleon and its variation with mass number, nuclear fission, nuclear fusion.

chapters.subject: Physics
chapters.chapter: Semiconductor Electronics: Materials, Devices and Simple Circuits
chapters.typology: Energy Bands, p-n Junction Diode (Forward/Reverse), Half/Full Wave Rectifier
chapters.official_topics: Energy bands in conductors, semiconductors and insulators (qualitative ideas only). Intrinsic and extrinsic semiconductors- p and n type, p-n junction diode: I-V characteristics in forward and reverse bias, application of diode as a rectifier (half wave and full wave).

Physics.official_board: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE, Delhi)

Chemistry.subject: Chemistry

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Henry's Law, Raoult's Law, Colligative Properties, Van't Hoff Factor
chapters.official_topics: Types of solutions, concentration expressions of solids in liquids, solubility of gases in liquids (Henry's law), solid solutions, Raoult's law, colligative properties (relative lowering of VP, elevation of BP, depression of FP, osmotic pressure), determination of molecular mass, abnormal molecular mass, Van't Hoff factor.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Kohlrausch Law, Nernst Equation, Cell EMF, Gibbs Energy, Fuel Cells & Corrosion
chapters.official_topics: Redox reactions, EMF of a cell, standard electrode potential, Nernst equation and applications to chemical cells, relation between Gibbs energy and EMF, conductance in electrolytic solutions, specific and molar conductivity, variations with concentration, Kohlrausch's Law, electrolysis laws, dry cells, Galvanic cells, lead accumulator, fuel cells, corrosion.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Rate Law, Order and Molecularity, Integrated Rate Equations (0 & 1st Order), Arrhenius Activation Energy
chapters.official_topics: Rate of reaction (average and instantaneous), factors affecting rate (concentration, temperature, catalyst), order and molecularity, rate law and specific rate constant, integrated rate equations and half-life (zero and first order only), collision theory (elementary qualitative), activation energy, Arrhenius equation.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Electronic Configuration, Transition Properties, Lanthanoid Contraction, KMnO4 & K2Cr2O7
chapters.official_topics: Electronic configuration, occurrence, characteristics of transition metals, general trends in first row (metallic character, ionization enthalpy, oxidation states, ionic radii, colour, catalytic properties, magnetic properties, interstitial compounds, alloy formation). Preparation and properties of K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4. Lanthanoids (electronic config, oxidation states, lanthanoid contraction consequences). Actinoids comparison.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: IUPAC Nomenclature, Isomerism, Valence Bond Theory (VBT), Crystal Field Theory (CFT), Spectrochemical Series
chapters.official_topics: Ligands, coordination number, colour, magnetic properties and shapes, IUPAC nomenclature of mononuclear complexes. Bonding: Werner's theory, VBT, and CFT; structure and stereoisomerism, importance in qualitative analysis, extraction of metals and biological systems.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: SN1 & SN2 Mechanisms, Stereochemistry, Elimination, Polyhalogen Compounds
chapters.official_topics: Haloalkanes: Nomenclature, nature of C-X bond, physical and chemical properties, optical rotation mechanism (SN1 and SN2). Haloarenes: Nature of C-X bond, substitution reactions (directive influence in monosubstituted). Uses/environmental effects of dichloromethane, chloroform, iodoform, freons, DDT.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Acidity of Phenols, Reimer-Tiemann, Kolbe, Williamson Synthesis, Lucas Test
chapters.official_topics: Alcohols: Nomenclature, preparation, properties of primary alcohols, test for 1°, 2°, 3°, dehydration mechanism, uses of methanol/ethanol. Phenols: Preparation, properties, acidic nature, electrophilic substitution, Kolbe, Reimer-Tiemann, uses. Ethers: Nomenclature, preparation, physical/chemical properties, Williamson synthesis.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Nucleophilic Addition, Aldol, Cannizzaro, Clemmensen, Hell-Volhard-Zelinsky (HVZ)
chapters.official_topics: Aldehydes and Ketones: Nomenclature, carbonyl nature, preparation, properties, nucleophilic addition mechanism, alpha-hydrogen reactivity, uses. Carboxylic Acids: Nomenclature, acidic nature, preparation, properties, HVZ reaction, uses.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Basicity Order, Hoffmann Bromamide, Carbylamine, Diazonium Salts & Coupling Reactions
chapters.official_topics: Nomenclature, classification, structure, preparation, properties, identification of 1°, 2°, 3° amines. Diazonium salts: Preparation, chemical reactions and synthetic importance.

chapters.subject: Chemistry
chapters.typology: Glucose Structure, D/L Config, Amino Acids (Zwitterion), Proteins (Peptide bond, Denaturation), DNA/RNA, Vitamins
chapters.official_topics: Carbohydrates (aldoses/ketoses, monosaccharides: glucose/fructose, D-L config, oligosaccharides, polysaccharides: starch, cellulose, glycogen). Proteins (amino acids, peptide bond, primary/secondary/tertiary/quaternary structure qualitative, denaturation, enzymes). Hormones, Vitamins (classification), Nucleic Acids (DNA & RNA).

Chemistry.official_board: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE, Delhi)

Mathematics.subject: Mathematics

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Equivalence Relations, Reflexive/Symmetric/Transitive, One-One and Onto Functions
chapters.official_topics: Types of relations: reflexive, symmetric, transitive and equivalence relations. One to one and onto functions.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Definition, Range, Domain, Principal Value Branches
chapters.official_topics: Definition, range, domain, principal value branch. Graphs of inverse trigonometric functions.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Matrix Operations, Transpose, Symmetric/Skew Symmetric, Invertible Matrices
chapters.official_topics: Concept, notation, order, equality, types of matrices, zero and identity matrix, transpose of a matrix, symmetric and skew symmetric matrices. Operation on matrices: Addition and multiplication and multiplication with a scalar. Non-commutativity of multiplication of matrices, invertible matrices and proof of the uniqueness of inverse.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Determinant Evaluation, Adjoint, Inverse, System of Linear Equations using Matrix Method
chapters.official_topics: Determinant of a square matrix (up to 3 x 3 matrices), minors, co-factors and applications of determinants in finding the area of a triangle. Adjoint and inverse of a square matrix. Solving system of linear equations in two or three variables (having unique solution) using inverse of a matrix.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Continuity at a Point, Chain Rule, Implicit Differentiation, Logarithmic Differentiation, Second Order Derivatives
chapters.official_topics: Continuity and differentiability, derivative of composite functions, chain rule, derivative of inverse trigonometric functions, derivative of implicit functions. Concept of exponential and logarithmic functions. Derivatives of logarithmic and exponential functions. Logarithmic differentiation, derivative of functions expressed in parametric forms. Second order derivatives.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Rate of Change, Increasing/Decreasing Functions, Maxima and Minima (First/Second Derivative Tests)
chapters.official_topics: Applications of derivatives: rate of change of bodies, increasing/decreasing functions, maxima and minima (first derivative test motivated geometrically and second derivative test given as a provable tool). Simple problems.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Integration by Substitution, Partial Fractions, By Parts, Definite Integrals Properties (King's Rule)
chapters.official_topics: Integration as inverse process of differentiation. Integration of a variety of functions by substitution, by partial fractions and by parts. Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (without proof). Basic properties of definite integrals and evaluation of definite integrals.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.chapter: Applications of the Integrals (Area under Curves)
chapters.typology: Area bounded by simple curves (Circles, Parabolas, Ellipses, Lines)
chapters.official_topics: Applications in finding the area under simple curves, especially lines, circles/parabolas/ellipses (in standard form only).

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Order & Degree, Variable Separable, Homogeneous, Linear Differential Equations (Integrating Factor)
chapters.official_topics: Definition, order and degree, general and particular solutions of a differential equation. Formation of differential equation whose general solution is given. Solution of differential equations by method of separation of variables, solutions of homogeneous differential equations of first order and first degree. Solutions of linear differential equation of the type: dy/dx + py = q.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Dot Product, Cross Product, Projection of a Vector on a Line, Direction Cosines
chapters.official_topics: Vectors and scalars, magnitude and direction of a vector. Direction cosines and direction ratios of a vector. Types of vectors (equal, unit, zero, parallel and collinear vectors), position vector of a point, negative of a vector, components of a vector, addition of vectors, multiplication of a vector by a scalar, position vector of a point dividing a line segment in a given ratio. Definition, properties and application of scalar (dot) product of vectors, vector (cross) product of vectors.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Equation of Line in Space, Angle between Lines, Shortest Distance between Skew Lines
chapters.official_topics: Direction cosines and direction ratios of a line joining two points. Cartesian equation and vector equation of a line, coplanar and skew lines, shortest distance between two lines. Angle between two lines.

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Graphical Method, Feasible Region (Bounded/Unbounded), Objective Function Optimization
chapters.official_topics: Introduction, related terminology such as constraints, objective function, optimization, graphical method of solution for problems in two variables, feasible and infeasible regions (bounded or unbounded), feasible and infeasible solutions, optimal feasible solutions (up to three non-trivial constraints).

chapters.subject: Mathematics
chapters.typology: Conditional Probability, Multiplication Theorem, Independent Events, Total Probability, Bayes Theorem
chapters.official_topics: Conditional probability, multiplication rule on probability, independent events, total probability, Bayes' theorem, Random variable and its probability distribution, mean of random variable.

Mathematics.official_board: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE, Delhi)

Biology.subject: Biology

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Micro/Megasporogenesis, Pollination, Double Fertilization, Endosperm & Embryo Development
chapters.official_topics: Flower structure; development of male and female gametophytes; pollination - types, agencies and examples; outbreeding devices; pollen-pistil interaction; double fertilization; post fertilization events - development of endosperm and embryo, development of seed and formation of fruit; special modes - apomixis, parthenocarpy, polyembryony; Significance of seed dispersal and fruit formation.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Male/Female Systems, Spermatogenesis, Oogenesis, Menstrual Cycle, Fertilization, Parturition
chapters.official_topics: Male and female reproductive systems; microscopic anatomy of testis and ovary; gametogenesis - spermatogenesis and oogenesis; menstrual cycle; fertilisation, embryo development up to blastocyst formation, implantation; pregnancy and placenta formation; parturition; lactation.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Contraceptive Methods, MTP, STDs, Infertility & Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART - IVF, ZIFT, GIFT)
chapters.official_topics: Need for reproductive health and prevention of Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs); birth control - need and methods, contraception and medical termination of pregnancy (MTP); amniocentesis; infertility and assisted reproductive technologies - IVF, ZIFT, GIFT.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Mendelian Genetics, Incomplete Dominance, Co-dominance, Linkage, Recombination, Sex Determination, Pedigree, Genetic Disorders
chapters.official_topics: Heredity and variation: Mendelian inheritance; deviations from Mendelism - incomplete dominance, co-dominance, multiple alleles and inheritance of blood groups, pleiotropy; elementary idea of polygenic inheritance; chromosome theory of inheritance; chromosomes and genes; Sex determination - in humans, birds and honey bee; linkage and crossing over; sex linked inheritance - haemophilia, colour blindness; Mendelian disorders in humans - thalassemia, phenylketonuria, sickle cell anemia; chromosomal disorders in humans: Down's, Turner's and Klinefelter's syndromes.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: DNA Structure, Packaging, Replication, Transcription, Genetic Code, Translation, Lac Operon, Human Genome Project
chapters.official_topics: Search for genetic material and DNA as genetic material; Structure of DNA and RNA; DNA packaging; DNA replication; Central Dogma; transcription, genetic code, translation; gene expression and regulation - lac operon; Genome, Human and rice genome projects; DNA fingerprinting.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Origin of Life, Homologous/Analogous Organs, Darwinism, Hardy-Weinberg Equilibrium, Human Evolution
chapters.official_topics: Origin of life; biological evolution and evidences for biological evolution (paleontology, comparative anatomy, embryology and molecular evidences); Darwin's contribution, modern synthetic theory of evolution; mechanism of evolution - variation (mutation and recombination) and natural selection with examples, types of natural selection; Gene flow and genetic drift; Hardy-Weinberg's principle; adaptive radiation; human evolution.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Pathogens (Malaria, Typhoid, Pneumonia, Amoebiasis, Ringworm), Immunity (Innate, Acquired, Vaccines), AIDS, Cancer, Drug Abuse
chapters.official_topics: Pathogens; parasites causing human diseases (malaria, dengue, chikungunya, filariasis, ascariasis, typhoid, pneumonia, common cold, amoebiasis, ring worm) and their control; Basic concepts of immunology - vaccines; cancer, HIV and AIDS; Adolescence - drug and alcohol abuse.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Household Products, Industrial Production (Antibiotics, Fermentation), Sewage Treatment, Biogas, Biocontrol, Biofertilizers
chapters.official_topics: Microbes in food processing, industrial production, sewage treatment, energy generation and as biocontrol agents and biofertilizers. Antibiotics; production and judicious use.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Restriction Enzymes, Cloning Vectors (pBR322), PCR, Gel Electrophoresis, Bioreactors, Downstream Processing
chapters.official_topics: Genetic Engineering (Recombinant DNA Technology). Restriction enzymes, cloning vectors, competent host transformation, processes of recombinant DNA technology (isolation of DNA, PCR, insertion, bioreactors, downstream processing).

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Bt Cotton, RNA Interference (RNAi), Genetically Engineered Insulin, Gene Therapy (ADA Deficiency), Transgenic Animals
chapters.official_topics: Application of biotechnology in health and agriculture: Human insulin and vaccine production, stem cell technology, gene therapy; genetically modified organisms - Bt crops; transgenic animals; biosafety issues, biopiracy and patents.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Population Attributes, Growth Models (Exponential, Logistic), Population Interactions (Mutualism, Competition, Predation, Parasitism)
chapters.official_topics: Organisms and environment: Habitat and niche, abiotic factors, adaptations; populations: population attributes, growth, birth rate, death rate, age distribution. Population interactions - mutualism, competition, predation, parasitism; population attributes - growth, birth rate and death rate, age distribution.

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Productivity (GPP, NPP), Decomposition, Energy Flow, Ecological Pyramids
chapters.official_topics: Ecosystems: Patterns, components; productivity and decomposition; energy flow; pyramids of number, biomass, energy (nutrients cycling excluded).

chapters.subject: Biology
chapters.typology: Patterns of Biodiversity (Species-Area Relationship), Loss of Biodiversity (Evil Quartet), In-situ & Ex-situ Conservation
chapters.official_topics: Concept of biodiversity; patterns of biodiversity; importance of biodiversity; loss of biodiversity; biodiversity conservation; hotspots, endangered organisms, extinction, Red Data Book, Sacred Groves, biosphere reserves, national parks, wildlife, sanctuaries and Ramsar sites.

Biology.official_board: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE, Delhi)

Computer Science.subject: Computer Science

chapters.subject: Computer Science
chapters.typology: Scope of Variables (Local/Global), Default/Positional Arguments, Built-in Modules
chapters.official_topics: Review of Python basics, conditional statements, loops, strings, lists, tuples, dictionaries. Functions: scope, parameter passing, default parameters, positional arguments, return values.

chapters.subject: Computer Science
chapters.typology: read(), readline(), readlines(), pickle dump()/load(), csv reader()/writer()
chapters.official_topics: Need for data file handling, types of files (text, binary, CSV). Text file: opening, closing, read(), readline(), readlines(), write(), writelines(). Binary file: pickle module (dump, load). CSV file: csv module (reader, writer, delimiter).

chapters.subject: Computer Science
chapters.typology: Push and Pop operations using Python List, LIFO Principles
chapters.official_topics: Stack operations: Push, Pop, Peek using Python list. Applications of stack in expression evaluation and reversal.

chapters.subject: Computer Science
chapters.typology: Topologies (Star, Bus), Network Devices (Switch, Router, Gateway), Protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, DNS), 4-Mark Layout Case Study
chapters.official_topics: Evolution of networking, data communication terminologies, transmission media (wired & wireless), network devices (hub, switch, router, gateway), topologies (bus, star, tree), protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, FTP, DNS), network security concepts.

chapters.subject: Computer Science
chapters.typology: SELECT queries, Aggregate Functions, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, Joins (Equi-join)
chapters.official_topics: Relational data model, domain, tuple, relation, keys (primary, candidate, alternate, foreign). SQL: DDL, DML commands, SELECT with WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX), JOINS (Cartesian product, Equi-join, Natural join).

chapters.subject: Computer Science
chapters.typology: mysql.connector, cursor.execute(), fetchone(), fetchall(), commit()
chapters.official_topics: Connecting Python with MySQL database using mysql.connector, establishing connection, creating cursor, executing queries (fetch, insert, update, delete), commit and rollback.

Computer Science.official_board: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE, Delhi)

English Core.subject: English Core

chapters.subject: English Core
chapters.typology: One unseen passage (12M) + One case-based factual passage (10M)
chapters.official_topics: Unseen factual and discursive passages (with conceptual understanding, decoding, analyzing, inferring, interpreting and vocabulary). Case-based factual passages with visual data/charts.

chapters.subject: English Core
chapters.typology: Notice (4M), Formal/Informal Invitations (4M), Letter to Editor/Job Application (5M), Article/Report (5M)
chapters.official_topics: Short writing tasks: Notice writing, formal/informal invitation and reply. Long writing tasks: Letters based on verbal/visual input (Application for a job with bio-data/resume, Letter to Editor), Article writing and Report writing.

chapters.subject: English Core
chapters.typology: Poetry extract (6M), Vistas extract (4M), Flamingo prose extract (6M), Short/Long questions (24M)
chapters.official_topics: Flamingo Prose: The Last Lesson, Lost Spring, Deep Water, The Rattrap, Indigo, Poets and Pancakes, The Interview, Going Places. Flamingo Poetry: My Mother at Sixty-Six, Keeping Quiet, A Thing of Beauty, A Roadside Stand, Aunt Jennifer's Tigers. Vistas Supplementary: The Third Level, The Tiger King, Journey to the End of the Earth, The Enemy, On the Face of It, Memories of Childhood.

English Core.official_board: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE, Delhi)
